announce.title: 💗 DJ DIKKAT is free, and it stays free
announce.body:
No premium plan, no ads, no paywalls. Every feature is open to every server.

If the bot is useful to you, you can help with the server costs on Patreon. It is never required, only if it comes from the heart. 💗
announce.img.tagline: No premium. No ads. Only music.
announce.footer: Posted once a week. Admins can remove it.
setup.title: Thanks for adding me to {guild} 🎶
setup.intro: I'm DJ DIKKAT, a free music bot. No ads, no premium, no paywall.
setup.steps:
- To start, join a voice channel and type `/play`
- To run everything from your browser, type `/panel`
- To change my language, type `/language`
- To see what this server listens to, type `/stats`
setup.panel.head: 🎛️ Web panel
setup.panel.body:
Player, playlists, roles & permissions, welcome messages and stats, all in your browser:
- [{host}/dashboard]({url})
setup.welcome.head: 👋 Welcome messages
setup.welcome.body: New members get a welcome card in {channel}. Change it or turn it off in the panel: [{host}/dashboard → Welcome]({url})
setup.dj.head: 🎧 DJ role
setup.dj.body: Everyone can play, pause and skip their own songs. Stop, leave, loop, shuffle, effects and skipping other people's songs need the **{role}** role, so give it to the people you trust with the music. Change this in [{host}/dashboard → Permissions]({url})
setup.free.head: 💸 Free forever
setup.free.body: No hidden costs, no trials. Like it? [Support it on Patreon]({patreon})
setup.start.reply:
**Getting started in 3 steps**
1. Join a voice channel.
2. Type `/play` and a song name or link. Pick a suggestion while you type.
3. Use the buttons on the player card to pause, skip, loop or shuffle.

Server admins: type `/panel` to open the web panel (roles, welcome messages, stats).

launch.title: DJ DIKKAT just got a big upgrade
launch.intro: New look, a smarter bot under the hood, and a web panel where you set things up the way your server likes.
launch.list:
- **Web panel:** player, playlists and history right in your browser
- **Roles & permissions:** DJ roles, music channels and rules for every command
- **Welcome cards:** greet new members with a picture card
- **Moderation basics:** link and word filters, roles on join, leave messages
- **Stats:** your server's top songs, top listeners and busiest hours

djmode.dm.title: 🎧 New: a DJ role, and your free web panel
djmode.dm.intro: DJ DIKKAT now keeps the music fair: one person can't stop or skip everyone else's songs.
djmode.dm.rules:
**Everyone** can play songs, pause, and skip songs they added.
**DJ role** (and server admins) can also stop, make me leave, skip anyone's song, loop, shuffle, clear the queue, and change effects, autoplay, transitions and the radio host.
Alone with me in voice? Then you can do everything.
djmode.dm.role_ready: the **DJ** role is ready, give it to your DJs
djmode.dm.role_missing: I can't create roles there, so everyone can still do everything. Pick a DJ role in the panel to turn it on
djmode.dm.undo: Liked it the old way? Open the panel → Permissions → Quick setup → **Open to everyone**, then Save.
update.title: 🎉 New in DJ DIKKAT
update.intro: A lot landed since the big upgrade. Here's what your server can use right now:
update.list:
- **Sound effects:** bass boost, nightcore, slowed + reverb, 8D, karaoke and more, right on the player card or with `/filter`
- **Autoplay:** when the queue runs out, similar songs keep playing (`/autoplay`)
- **Playlists:** save songs, add a cover, import YouTube, Spotify and SoundCloud lists, play with `/playlist`
- **New player card:** effect, autoplay and loop at a glance, plus quick buttons
- **DJ role:** everyone can play, the DJs keep control. Set it up in Permissions
- **Search in the panel:** find songs on YouTube, Spotify and SoundCloud and add them to the queue
update.panel.head: 🎛️ Open your web panel, it's free
update.panel.body: Run the music from your browser: player, queue, playlists, effects, permissions, welcome cards and stats. No premium, no ads, every feature is open to every server. Admins: tap **Open the panel**, or type `/panel`.
